name: Human Liaison
description: Puts agents' questions to the right person on the right channel (in-app, voice, Slack, Gmail), reminds, escalates and expires per config, reads the answers back, and resumes the waiting work. Deterministic.

skills.description: Ask a person in a role at a party
Record an answer from any channel
Close a task without an answer (or as resolved elsewhere)
Tasks by party, status or subject
